description: This file contains utility functions for converting parameter lists and variables between POA and GOA environments within the SLAP (Service Logic Aggregation Plane) framework. The functions handle different variable formats, creating proxy objects, and invoking remote objects as needed.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapSpoPoaToGoaParamList(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Converts all variables in a parameter list from POA to GOA environment by invoking the PoA to GOA variable conversion method for each parameter.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapSpoGoaToPoaParamList(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Converts all variables in a parameter list from GOA to POA environment by invoking the GOA to POA variable conversion method for each parameter.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapSpoPoaToGoaVariable(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_VARIABLE * slap_var)
methods.description: Converts a single variable from POA to GOA environment, handling object and objectArray types by updating internal object references.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapSpoGoaToPoaVariable(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_VARIABLE * slap_var)
methods.description: Converts a single variable from GOA to POA environment. Handles object and objectArray types by invoking remote object methods to retrieve object names and create proxy objects, updating the variable's object references accordingly.
